title: PUT /api/areas/{area_id}/room-climate
description: Admin only. The room climate sensors of an area (area page, Raumklima): null = automatic (the rule of data/room-climate.json), else one entity placed in the area that reports the measure (a thermostat of the measure's device_domains or a sensor of its device_class; an excluded one may be picked on purpose). Both keys replace the stored choice. Refused with 422 and detail {code: room_climate_invalid, measure, entity_id, message} for any other entity; nothing is stored then. Answers like GET (room-climate.response.json); connected apps get the area again (room_climate).
